income_unit: nominal yuan per person per year; monthly divides by 12
quantity_model_unit: fixed-reference-basket equivalent jin per person per month
food_valuation: sum of commodity community prices times total consumption quantities; purchase+own+gift
price_caveat: other-meat prices use calibrated category-quality-range proxy; all fixed item scales derive from category ranges and are exploratory
pork_definition: roulei_1 pork plus roulei_2 pork ribs; unknown-species processed meat remains other meat
nut_definition: shuiguo_6 only; dried fruits/fruit preserves remain fruit products
